Merge pull request #187 from igorbolic/sb-4

Upgrade to Spring Boot 4.0 and Java 17

commits.author: Igor Bolic
commits.message:
Upgrade to Spring Boot 4.0 and Java 17

This update migrates the library to support Spring Boot 4.0.x
and Spring Framework 7.0.x. Since these versions require Java 17,
the library's code baseline has been changed from Java 8 to Java 17.

commits.message:
Merge pull request #186 from igorbolic/spotless

Use Spotless for license headers and code formatting

commits.author: Igor Bolic
commits.message:
Use Spotless for license headers and code formatting

The License Gradle Plugin depends on an older `spring-core` version
that conflicts with Spring Boot 4, therefore these two plugins cannot
be used together.

Replace License Gradle Plugin with Spotless for applying license headers
and code formatting.

Resolves #185

Merge pull request #182 from igorbolic/xmemcached-client-customizer

Add support for customizing the `XMemcachedClient`

commits.author: Igor Bolic
commits.message:
Add support for customizing the `XMemcachedClient`

Besides configuring the Memcached client through application properties,
the `XMemcachedClientCustomizer` should allow users to fine-tune the
`XMemcachedClient` with their own configuration. This gives users more
flexibility when the default Memcached client configuration options are
not sufficient for a specific use case.

Resolves: #180
